description: Marvones wears a deep plum long tailored outer coat over a cream linen tunic with a short standing split collar. Narrow gold geometric embroidery edges the coat opening, sleeves and hem, with matching decoration around the under-tunic neckline and cuffs. A broad dark brown decorated leather belt has round metal ornaments, a square central buckle and a long hanging strap. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the ensemble. The coat hangs to just below the knees and the cream linen cuffs show clearly. Both hands rest naturally beside the body. There is no headgear, armor, weapon or crown.
